sql: select x.scenario_key, (select string_agg('[' || (e->>'turn') || '] ' || (e->>'who') || coalesce('/' || (e->>'kind'), '') || ': ' || left(replace(e->>'text', E'\n', ' '), case when e->>'who' = 'ferramenta' then 260 else 260 end), ' ## ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.transcript) e where coalesce(e->>'kind','') <> 'image') as t from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = (select id from public.ai_sim_runs order by created_at desc limit 1) and x.scenario_key in ('feriado','sem_preferencia_datas')
